extractor.method: supervised bidirectional GRU token roles with copied entities/numbers and learned event class
extractor.split: disjoint graph identities; held-out lexical/order families and unseen entity ids; 192 negative distractor/conflict sentences
extractor.selection: last epoch, fixed threshold, no test selection

memory.raw: append-only SQLite JSON content SHA256; immutable identity task/title/version
memory.vector: deterministic hashed bag of words cosine, separate applicability filtering

halting.candidate_source: synthetic controlled residual trajectories, separately labeled; root integrates learned candidates
halting.proof: sum absolute residuals along root-to-query dependency path is a bound on query error

statistics: report individual seeds; memory examples independent generated tasks; no pooled independence claim
limits: structured affine compaction, not learned general summarization
